name: Orascom Investment Holding
source: Issuer annual report, KPMG Luxembourg audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, statement of profit or loss on page 8, in thousands of US dollars. Every revenue, expense, profit and tax line is as printed. Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed expense lines: purchases and services 9132, other expenses 484, increase in provisions 1670, personnel cost 6446 and depreciation and amortization 1085 for 2024, and 4761, 225, 1487, 9081 and 1627 for 2023. Net Finance Costs is the printed finance expense less the printed finance income, so a negative figure is a net finance income. The 2023 income tax line is a printed tax credit, stored negative so that profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Net Profit is the loss for the year from continuing operations; the 2023 loss for the year including discontinued operations is 39302. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are not printed by this issuer, whose profit or loss is presented by nature with no cost of sales line. EPS is in US dollars per share.
statementTitle: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss
